text:
anya: quick heads-up — eval CI shows a regression after quantized bring-up of rfn-ggml-v2. mt-bench pass rate down ~6% (quality metric opt).

mike: which job? can you paste the CI link and the failing metric?

anya: eng-ml/canary-evals#3456
anya: metric: mt_blend_pass_rate: baseline 0.92 -> 0.86 on q8-fp fallback

sam: repro locally on my devbox with q8 kernel + kv-cache disabled. running bisect now.

eval-bot: bisect result: commit e1a3f4c -> introduced kernel change: 'q8_matmul_accumulate_fix'

zoe: that's the one that changed accumulation order to reduce fp drift. weird if it regresses accuracy.

mike: can you share runner logs? any exceptions or cache mismatches?

sam: logs show mismatched KV lookup on token 73 for a subset of prompts. snippet:
```
[runner] kv_get: idx=73 expected=0x1f2b got=0x0
[model] fallback -> recompute k/v
```

zoe: that sounds like an index overflow in the quant kernel when sequence length > 2048 and cache compacting enabled.

anya: customer canary on dedicated saw errors too. suggested rollback of e1a3f4 from canary pending root cause.

mike: +1 rollback on canary. i'll open a PR to pin model build to previous kernel (hash d9b7a11) and trigger canary redeploy.

sam: created issue eng-ml#512: 'q8-kernel-kv-indexing-off-by-one', attaching repro and bisect log.

eval-bot: CI rerun (rollback) started for canary. tracking: https://ci.internal/runs/98765

zoe: next steps: reproduce minimal kernel case, add assertion in kv indexing, add integration test for seq length=4096.

anya: thanks — keeping this as release blocker until canary passes and mt_blend_pass_rate within 0.5% of baseline. :eyes:

mike: noted. ping me when rerun complete, i'll coordinate rollout rollback if canary still fails.
